notes.title: Update v0.85 - Winter Sale
notes.notes:
[h1]Winter Sale [/h1]
The game was not selling so good as I hoped (15 copies in 10 months), so I have decided to bring it more to people by starting a 90% discount sale.


[h1]Patchnotes v0.85[/h1]
Added functionality to be able to equip all towers of all character classes:
[list]
[*] On easy you have a chance of 90% to get your own characters towers and each 5% for a tower of another character class
[*] On medium you have a chance of 66% to get your own characters towers and each 17% for a tower of another character class
[*] On hard there´s a 33% chance for all tower classes to spawn
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed overlapping scrollbars in inventory and character creation
[*] Fixed duping bug when finished map and you are dropping items from inventory (storage)
[*] Fixed bug, where no wood is spawning
[*] Fixed wrong informations in help menu
[*] Fixed resources spawning under ground
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.6b
notes.notes:
There´s currently a bug with the events when trying to edit them, so the new patchnotes with some fixes are coming here, until I can edit the old event^^


[h2]Patchnotes v0.6b[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed Chests to spawn items of enemies level
[*] Fixed the "next wave timer" in lobby to don´t show up, when closing the shop
[*] Changed routes on first map to be a little bit lower
[*] Added bridge of first map in minimap texture
[*] Changed all random stats to be more random
[*] Fixed tooltip for damage area in inventory (was explosion radius)
[/list]

notes.title: New map, Release Notice, Balancing and some other stuff
notes.notes:
[h1]Release-Day[/h1]
Hey there,
today I will release this game (february 20, 2020) as planned

[b]I want try to publish it at 02:00am UTC:[/b]
[list]
[*] PST 06:00pm (19th february)
[*] CET 03:00am (20th february)
[*] CST 10:00am (20th february)
[/list]
The times are not 100% guaranteed^^
I have no idea, if there is any limitation depending on steam, it´s my first game release...

[h2]New Map
[/h2]The new map of this update is called woodcutter camp, in mid of the jungle...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36146593/4963b0b27eb8ce5467652332ae827137202a84bf.png[/img]


[h2]Patchnotes v0.6[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new map "Woodcutter Camp"
[*] Inventory and LevelSelection can now be closed by pressing Escape
[*] Fixed bug with the route on ground, where the first route being visible even if the connected spawnpoint isn´t active
[*] Fixed bug on map 4, where the enemies got stuck sometimes on the road
[*] Changed Towers to decrease amount of resources when dismantled by 50% once after round was started since built ... before the resources got reduced by 25% every round 
[*] Reduced Upgrade Cost of Towers
[*] Increased Upgrade Effect of Towers
[*] Replaced ExplosionRadius by Area Damage
[*] All weapons and attacking towers have now area damage instead of only attacking one enemy
[*] Changed completely all stats of enemies, weapons and towers
[*] Fixed bug where removed stats (by changing equipment) are still added to character´s stats
[*] Reduced amount of stats for each level, base is the same  but only a part of it gets added for each level (25%) ... same for enemies depending on difficulty
[*] Reimported crosshair
[*] Increased size of crosshair
[*] Fixed some UI bugs, like wrong names, typos, etc.
[/list]


[b]Would be nice to get some feedback^^[/b]
